title: README does not say where run artifacts are written
summary: The issue reports that the README lacks information about where the demo's output artifacts are stored. The user cannot locate the reports and suggests adding a brief description of the artifact layout, such as the `runs/<run-name>/` directory and its contents. Updating the documentation will help users find generated reports.
suggested_next_action: Add a short section to the README describing the artifact layout and the files generated in the `runs/<run-name>/` directory.
